name: TCP_COMMS_STATUS
notes: E1.33 Section 7.6.3. The GET response contains one TCP Comms Entry (87 octets) per Scope, one per ACK or ACK_OVERFLOW response. A SET resets the event counter of the given Scope.

subtypes.name: scope
subtypes.notes: Fixed 63 octet field: UTF-8 string of 1 to 62 octets, terminated and padded with null characters. The empty string is not a valid Scope; E133_DEFAULT_SCOPE is "default".

subtypes.name: broker_ipv4_address
subtypes.notes: 0.0.0.0 if there is no active IPv4 TCP connection.

subtypes.name: broker_ipv6_address
subtypes.notes: :: (all zero) if there is no active IPv6 TCP connection.

subtypes.name: broker_port
subtypes.notes: 0 if there is no active TCP connection.

set_request.name: scope
set_request.notes: Fixed 63 octet field: UTF-8 string of 1 to 62 octets, terminated and padded with null characters. The empty string is not a valid Scope; E133_DEFAULT_SCOPE is "default".
